opening.argument: The speaker promotes Forsage participation through personal earnings and the promise that viewers can “capitalize quickly.” He pairs that pitch with a goal of reaching “12 baskets in each matrix,” while the promotional frame displays “EARN LIMITLESS” and the Forsage website. Together with the claim that the smart contract is changing lives, these statements tie recruitment-style matrix participation to easy or unlimited earnings and establish a deceptive recruitment pitch.
